lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 오늘은 식생활 이야기를 나눠 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. Shall we talk about your diet today?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. oneureun siksaenghwal iyagireul nanwo bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 좋아요. 저는 작년에 식생활을 바꿨어요.
lines.en: Yes, sure. I changed my diet last year.
lines.roman: ne, joayo. jeoneun jangnyeone siksaenghwareul bakkwosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? What made you change it?
lines.learner: 건강 검진을 계기로 식생활을 바꾸게 됐어요.
lines.en: A health checkup led me to change my diet.
lines.roman: geongang geomjineul gyegiro siksaenghwareul bakkuge dwaesseoyo.

lines.en: My cholesterol level was quite high.

lines.beaver_en: So how do you eat these days?
lines.learner: 고기를 줄이고 채식 위주로 먹고 있어요.
lines.en: I eat less meat and mostly vegetarian food.
lines.roman: gogireul jurigo chaesik wijuro meokgo isseoyo.

lines.en: I cut carbs by eating multigrain rice instead of white rice.

lines.learner: 네, 그래도 영양가를 더 꼼꼼히 봐요.
lines.en: Yes, but I check nutritional value more carefully.
lines.roman: ne, geuraedo yeongyanggareul deo kkomkkomhi bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. Have you noticed any changes in your body?

lines.beaver: 대단하네요. 건강하게 먹으려면 뭐가 제일 중요할까요?
lines.beaver_en: That is great. What matters most for eating healthily?
lines.beaver_roman: daedanhaneyo. geonganghage meogeuryeomyeon mwoga jeil jungyohalkkayo?
lines.learner: 뭐니 뭐니 해도 채소를 많이 먹는 게 중요해요.
lines.en: Above all, eating lots of vegetables is important.
lines.roman: mwoni mwoni haedo chaesoreul mani meongneun ge jungyohaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: You've made a truly valuable change.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll keep up this diet from now on.

lines.beaver: 다음 검진 결과도 꼭 알려 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Please let me know your next checkup results too.
lines.beaver_roman: daeum geomjin gyeolgwado kkok allyeo juseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 꼭 알려 드릴게요. 오늘 감사했어요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll let you know. Thank you for today.
lines.roman: ne, kkok allyeo deurilgeyo. oneul gamsahaesseoyo.
